# James Moore & Co.

> > A nationwide CPA and tax accounting firm offering comprehensive accounting, assurance, tax, and business advisory services with specialized expertise in healthcare, collegiate athletics, and SBIR grants.

James Moore & Co. is an established accounting and consulting firm based in Gainesville, Florida, with 50+ years of experience serving businesses, nonprofits, and government entities. The firm provides a full range of services from outsourced accounting and bookkeeping to fractional CFO services, audit and assurance, and specialized industry solutions.

- CPA Services

## Audit & Assurance Services

- [Audit, Review, and Compilation Services](https://www.jmco.com/services/assurance/audit-reviews-compilation): Audit, review, and compilation services for nonprofits and government entities
- [Agreed-Upon Procedures (AUP)](https://www.jmco.com/services/assurance/agreed-upon-procedures): Agreed-upon procedures as audit alternative for targeted organization concerns
- [NCAA Agreed-Upon Procedures](https://www.jmco.com/services/assurance/ncaa-agreed-upon-procedures): NCAA compliance and agreed-upon procedures for Division I athletic departments

## Industry-Specific Solutions
